answer: Standing lapses unless 4 peers re-attest it every 8 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in marble and opal lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the willow graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1703 impostors cost 312 times the honest price and take 3 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
